quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology IR activity record: 2026-04 (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): for servers - which the company treats as a core future direction - it has launched IM, AE, AM and AS series MLCCs with low ESR and long-term reliability above 105 C; its high-voltage and high-capacitance mid/high-voltage MLCC series are widely used in server multiphase power modules. It also launched MF, MI, MT, MG and MS alloy current-sense resistors for server and GPU power (MT Kelvin sensing for GPU power balance). New products are progressively passing customer certification.
